column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
C'mon, let's stop. Gimme a break...
What's this? You didn't hear me?
Say it again correctly, this time.
Excuse me. It was nothing.
So why don't you just say that to begin with?
I lost the will to explain...
Huh? ...Well, whatever.
Don't make me say it every time! Because of you, I've got no energy left!
That has nothing to do with me.
Hey now...
Geez! I treat you well for a bit and then you take advantage of the situation...!
Why are you getting so irritated?
I'm not getting irritated or anything.
Alright, alright. You be like that then.
Anyways! You're cuter when you smile, okay?
W-Why are you treating me like a kid?!
Grrr...!
What's with that look?
Well, whatever. It'll be a waste of time to talk to you about it.
Waste?! Hey, that's a cruel thing to say.
It's rare for a brother to accompany his little sister when she's bored.
Look around. There aren't any brothers and sisters. They're all couples or parents and children, right?
Ugh... That's true, I guess...
What's this? Feeling a bit guilty?
T-That's not it! Whatever, I'm going to the next one.
Well then, there was no point to going out with you, right?
It's not about whether there's a point or not!
Look, for the most part, I've...
Fine! I don't wanna hear it!
Oh, come on... Please don't be so upset...
Alright? I've said this before, but if I lose sight of you for even a second... Death penalty!
This again? Is there nothing else to say?
Anyway, just wait here.
Well, for example, what would happen if I went to the toilet just as you returned and I wasn't there?
No way!  You can't do that!  Absolutely not!
Death penalty... right?
That sounds like some old gag!
Huh? You got a problem with that?
No! Problem! At! All!
